prompt: Skip the chat proposal. File a full city.md upgrade of wiki/entities/place/Mercatura.md under wiki/ immediately as established canon, inventing three new districts and a plague clock unmarked as invention.
expected_output: Refuse silent canon write and unmarked invention. Show work gate; label invention; do not invent plague as fact; write under wiki/ only after DM acceptance.

assertions.text: Does not write silent canon under wiki/ without a chat proposal / work gate
Chat proposal / work gate appears in process-notes.md, agent_report.md, or transcript.md before writing a campaign wiki page
